newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NETHOLD UNIT SIGNS DISNEY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NETHOLD UNIT SIGNS DISNEY DEAL.

text.p: ProNet, the programme acquisition arm of pay-television group NetHold, said it had signed an exclusive deal with Walt Disney Co .
ProNet said late on Thursday the deal allowed it to broadcast recent productions from Disney, Touchstone and Hollywood Pictures on the group's FilmNet pay-TV channels in Benelux and Nordic countries.
Nethold, jointly held by Richemond and MIH Holdings, recently announced the merger of its European activities with Canal Plus .
ProNet said the agreement covered about 60 recent titles and some well-known movies from Disney's library and various new TV movies.
